lab_questions.title: Validate Config Syntax Brackets
lab_questions.description:
An automated linter validates structural syntax in configuration payloads. The linter must verify that every opening bracket '(', '{', '[' has a matching closing bracket ')', '}', ']' of the correct type in proper nested order.

Read a single string of bracket characters and print VALID if all brackets are properly matched and closed, or INVALID otherwise.

tasks.title: Test Case 1
tasks.description:
Validate your code against test case 1.
Input:
{[()]}
Expected Output: VALID

tasks.title: Test Case 2
tasks.description:
Validate your code against test case 2.
Input:
([)]
Expected Output: INVALID

tasks.title: Test Case 3
tasks.description:
Validate your code against test case 3.
Input:
((()))
Expected Output: VALID
